# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.15

*Version code 73*

## What's New

**A continuous Next Episode experience**
The End-of-Play card now follows the episode that is still playing. IntroDB, TheIntroDB or
StreamDek's internal timing decides when the card appears, while an autoplay countdown mirrors the
actual playable time remaining. The current episode continues behind the card and the next episode
starts when its intended ending is reached.

Source preparation happens quietly in the background and no longer controls when the card or
countdown begins. Selecting **Next Episode** always skips the wait and starts the transition
immediately. If preparation is still finishing, StreamDek moves into a lightweight loading state
instead of restarting the countdown.

**Clear handling for episodes that have not aired**
StreamDek now checks release metadata before offering autoplay. A future episode never receives a
countdown and StreamDek does not search for a source for it. The card explains that it has not aired
and offers **Skip Ending**, which completes the current episode without attempting the future one.
Suggestions may remain in the same card, so no second recommendation panel competes with it.

Missing or malformed release dates are treated as unknown rather than being incorrectly labelled
unaired, and an aired episode with no available stream remains an aired episode—not a scheduled one.

**New Mobile defaults, ready out of the box**
Fresh installs and settings that have never been changed now open with StreamDek's intended Mobile
experience: Dark appearance with the White theme, relaxed Home spacing, wide Continue Watching and
New Episode cards, logo tiles for streaming networks, Cinematic backgrounds at 50% ambient tint,
and full card titles.

Title pages default to the Classic layout, horizontal episode strips, regular season tabs and hidden
episode spoilers. Trailers default to 1080p with a three-second delay, automatic trailer playback
off and a 24-hour cache. Ratings remain clean on Home while expanded title-page services stay
available. Player gestures, floating playback and control labels are on, with the normal control
layout, a hidden fullscreen status bar and scrolling player titles.

## Improvements

- **New Episodes now means unwatched.** An episode already completed locally or through synced
  playback history is removed from the New Episodes row.
- **New Episode titles stay readable.** The Home card-title preference no longer shortens or hides
  titles in this row, and long End-of-Play explanations scroll instead of ending in an ellipsis.
- **Trailers prefer KinoCheck.** StreamDek gives KinoCheck a bounded first opportunity, then falls
  back to metadata and the existing YouTube path when it has no usable trailer.
- **Cleaner episode actions.** Restart Episode now sits beside the episode title, while Settings
  subpages use a compact back arrow without reducing the touch target.

## Fixed

- Fixed ordinary buffering immediately after a seek being mistaken for a stalled stream.
- Fixed autoplay countdowns running for a fixed duration unrelated to the current episode's ending.
- Fixed next-episode source discovery delaying, suppressing or restarting the End-of-Play flow.
- Fixed future and unknown episodes being able to enter an automatic next-episode transition.
- Fixed duplicate End-of-Play cards and competing recommendation countdowns.
